name: mysql
instructions: MySQL server with fixed connection (root@127.0.0.1). Pick a database and a SQL query per call.

commands.name: query
commands.description: Run a SQL query against the given database (mysql -uroot -psdfgsdfg -h127.0.0.1)

database.description: Database name to run the query against

query.description: SQL query to execute (e.g. SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10)
